title: Chapter 373 Killing The Red Team'S First General
content:
Chapter 373 Killing The Red Team'S First General

Wang Shuo's heart tightened.

"Prepare for battle." Wang Shuo shouted.

The red enemy's strength is still much inferior to Wang Shuo's side.

There are two generals, but the number of primary and intermediate generals is much less.

It seems that he should have just upgraded the level 2 base not long ago, just enough to summon generals, but no extra merit points to summon generals.

Wang Shuo killed the enemy's generals without hesitation.

At this time, the two generals of the opponent were dragged by the earth mother worm boss, which was the best time to pick up leaks.

After killing two enemy primary generals, the enemy general immediately issued an order to retreat.

Wang Shuo didn't care and ordered the army to press on, vowing to kill one of the enemy's generals to see if there was any additional effect.

What's the benefit if he is the first to kill the opponent's general!

Wang Shuo felt unwilling to give up.

In this way, he chased all the way. Wang Shuo strictly ordered not to attack the earth mother worm boss, and only chased the enemies in the enemy camp.

Neutral creatures have hatred. Before the enemy who attacks them dies, they will not attack others.

In this way, Wang Shuo and the red team chased out of the underground nest.

After coming to the ground, Wang Shuo summoned the three-headed dog of hell, whose combat power and speed were beyond the reach of the opponent.

Wang Shuo intercepted the two warriors on the opposite side.

"Hey, big brother, wait a minute, I am willing to give you all my resources, please let me live."

Seeing that he was surrounded and all his generals had died, the enemy general finally couldn't hold it anymore and began to beg for mercy.

Wang Shuo looked at the other party with the eyes of caring for mentally retarded children.

Without any nonsense, he launched an attack directly.

With the assistance of Zhu Tianguo and dozens of generals, everyone surrounded the two generals.

These two people were already trapped.

It didn't take long for Wang Shuo to kill them.

Looking at the corpse in front of him, Wang Shuo said calmly: "Brother, you are confused. If I kill you, all your resources will be mine!"

The two warriors finally dropped two Shura Orders.

As for other things, only the armor and weapons on them were left.

This is not of much value to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel disappointed.

[Congratulations, you are the first to kill a local warrior. The reward is 10,000 merit points. 】

This is more or less.

Wang Shuo returned to the previous cave, killed the injured dark gold boss, and got another Shura Order.

This place is obviously at the border with the enemy camp, and Wang Shuo didn't dare to stay for long.

He went back to his base directly.

At this time, both the red side and the purple side received news that a warrior of the purple side killed a warrior of the red side.

The summoned warriors are not counted as heads, but only the benefits, that is, the people killed will only get Shura Orders, but the number of warriors killed in the other camp will not be counted.

After all, both camps have only 100 places.

Countless generals were shocked by this news.

"Fuck, who is so brave?"

"This guy must be a huge threat to my competition for leadership!"

"Hey! Who is the unlucky guy who actually gave the other side a head? Fuck, he deserved to die!"

Of course, Wang Shuo couldn't hear these discussions.

At this time, there was no public channel for everyone to communicate.

Wang Shuo returned to the base.

Seeing the broken walls around him, he thought about it and decided to build the surrounding walls.
